findings.rule: Running title not exceeding 50 characters including spaces
Reference list must not contain entries like “In preparation.”; such citations are not allowed
Personal communications should appear parenthetically in the text, not as a reference entry
findings.problem: Reference [8] is a personal communication listed in the reference list

findings.rule: When a DOI is present it must be added as a URL (e.g., https://doi.org/…)
findings.problem: Reference [4] provides a DOI in the form “doi:10.1016/…”, not as a URL

findings.rule: Figures must be at 300 dpi resolution
Graphical abstract must be PNG, JPEG or GIF format
Each uploaded file must be ≤20 MB
findings.problem: Movie file is 45 MB, exceeding the limit

findings.rule: File names must contain only alphanumeric characters; no spaces or Japanese characters
findings.problem: File name contains Japanese characters and spaces

findings.rule: Text footnotes are not allowed from page 2 onward
findings.problem: Tables contain footnotes (e.g., “Footnotes: 1. …”) which constitute footnotes in the text beyond page 1
